item.title: Query Audit Logs
item.description: This section describes how to query audit logs. Audit logs: Records of requests received by the KubeSphere API server, i.e., the operational behavior of users on the KubeSphere platform. KubeSphere supports querying audit logs within the scope of a user’s permissions, whether as a regular user role or a cluster administrator role.
